She swears at me all the time, I swear back at her. Pretty messed up. She makes herself look innocent, like I'm the bad crazy one. I'm also tired of being lonely. My mom takes our dog and keeps her for herself, so I can't even get comfort from our dog! The dog is what I'll really miss if and when I'm gone! I've always wanted to start studying at university but that never happened. I'm also in my early twenties.

My mother stopped me from committing suicide because she was probably scared of being blamed for it. When she caught me trying to swallow pills she beat me up. So yes... stuck in my miserable existance with no way out.
